records.operator_notes: Context initialization/start are inlined, update and finish calls are preserved, and the zeroized free is optimized away consistently.
Two 64-bit loads, byte-to-word expansion, both weighted multiplies, addition, rounded shift call, and vector return align.
Capacity/free-space calculations, the two growth-position predicates, offset computation, relocation, and boolean return align.
Insertion-point calculation, end-growth memmove, beginning-growth pointer shift, size increment, and returned pointer align.
Top-level map lookup, end comparison, stored value extraction, and zero/default fallback align.
Opening delimiter, qualifier lookup/conditional print, mapper identifier output, and closing delimiter align.
Packed dimension exponent subtractions and per-unit/equation OR plus flag XOR fields feed the returned unit_data construction.
Model allocation/construction, interface ID retrieval, and tail call to map insertion align; no initializer is required for this specialization.
Dimension-size check, per-coordinate bounds and exception construction, coordinate stores, loop, and cleanup align.
Pointee and expression transforms, constant-expression context, rebuild conditions, dependent/nondependent type-location branches, and result align.
